text:
mira: Quick thought — before we lock the SLO-driven routing defaults, can we run a sim that shows how often circuit-breakers will trigger per tier and region? Need numbers to justify presets.
jamal: +1. Console should show expected fallback rate not just a checkbox. :eyes: 
alex: Agree. Add a small histogram and a fallback-rate estimate in the rollout preview.
olivia: Also show cost delta for switching to a cheaper model variant when fallback triggers. PMs keep asking for $$ impact.
mira: Example config I tested locally:
```json
{
  "tiers": {
    "free": {"p50_ms": 200, "cb_threshold": 0.2},
    "standard": {"p50_ms": 100, "cb_threshold": 0.1},
    "enterprise": {"p50_ms": 80, "cb_threshold": 0.03}
  },
  "region_overrides": {"eu": {"cb_threshold": 0.05}}
}
```
jamal: Nice. @policy-sim-bot can you run that config against a 7d production trace sample and return fallback counts + cost delta?
policy-sim-bot: Sim run started on sample: prod-7d-sample-2026-03. Running...
policy-sim-bot: Sim run complete. Summary: fallback_rates -> free: 12.4%, standard: 3.6%, enterprise: 0.5%. Region diff: eu +1.2% vs us. Estimated extra cost when falling back to cheaper variant: $120 / 100k reqs. :chart_with_upwards_trend: 
alex: Those numbers are actionable. Enterprise CB looks fine; maybe lower to 0.02 for HA customers.
olivia: UX suggestion: in rollout screen add an "Impact estimate" card with two toggles: "simulate on traffic sample" and "show regional breakdown". Also an export button for CSV.
mira: And add a slider with suggested presets: conservative (low fallbacks), balanced, aggressive (more fallbacks, lower cost).
jamal: Implementation note: policy engine must keep a fast-path for success so sim telemetry should be sampled at request-time and we should also maintain aggregated counters to avoid per-request overhead.
alex: Can we tag traces with fallback_reason (latency, capacity, model-error) so we can filter sim outcomes?
olivia: +1. If fallback_reason == model-error and rate > 0.5% we should page oncall.
mira: Action items: 
- jamal: wire policy-sim endpoint to console and expose regional sampling (ETA: Tue)
- alex: add fallback_reason tag in traces and ensure it's available to sim (ETA: Mon)
- olivia: produce UX mocks for Impact card + presets (ETA: Wed)
- policy-sim-bot: add CSV export and a short CSV schema summary (ETA: Fri)
policy-sim-bot: Acknowledged. CSV export & schema added to backlog.
mira: Thanks all — once jamal wires the sim we'll run it on a few customer cohorts and iterate on presets.
